adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, when `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT && userId` it returns the raw `fetch(...)` Response object. In `packages/app-store/hubspot/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the result of `await refreshOAuthTokens(...)` is assigned to `const hubspotRefreshToken: HubspotToken`, so with sync enabled it will actually be a `Response`, not a parsed token payload. Since `refreshOAuthTokens` does not JSON-parse the response, any later reads like `hubspotRefreshToken.expiresIn/accessToken` would be `undefined`, leading to incorrect/NaN expiry calculations and bad persistence.
